_readme: S605 SkySextans, 2026-11-08. 47 of Columbia's 52 failing records sum their major correctly and fail the degree check as incomplete: they name the degree total (60) and a GE pattern, either 'Columbia College General Education (CC-GE) Pattern or Cal-GETC Pattern' (26 local A.S./A.A. degrees, e.g. 06815 Child Development A.S.) or Cal-GETC (21 transfer degrees, e.g. 30798 Sociology AA-T), with no units for it. This read prints how the program pages word their general education and where the catalog states the units of CC-GE and Cal-GETC, so a reconcile step can cite the catalog's own figure. Two program loads plus the links they follow, no model call.

questions.ge_units: The units the catalog states for CC-GE and for Cal-GETC, and how a local degree page and a transfer degree page name them.
